title: SIGWINCH on WIN_CONFIGURE resize
acceptance_criteria: WIN_CONFIGURE handler computes new (cols, rows) from pixel dims and cell metrics
Emits SIGWINCH (signal 28) to fg_pgid via procmgr_pg_signal
stty size reports new dimensions after resize
completion_summary: COMP_WIN_CONFIGURE label (103) in libcluu. Compositor notifies cluuterm on win_register + resize_focused. Cluuterm resize_grid reallocates cell grid, updates pts.winsize, sends SIGWINCH via procmgr_pg_signal, triggers redraw.
